requirements.title: MCD Catalog and Offerings
requirements.description: Merge offerings from multiple sources into a single point of entry within the Bell Business Self-Service Center (BBSSC), including MCD catalog consolidation, Bell managed Meraki offering updates, and Datavalet offering reorganization.

requirements.title: Profile and Template Management
requirements.description: Enable transfer of site to another template/profile, modification of existing Bell-managed Meraki profiles, and creation of new profiles/templates with flexible technical details page.

requirements.title: CI Visibility Matrix
requirements.description: The matrix defines the visibility of configuration items (CIs) based on the offering type and target managed by.

requirements.title: Technical Details Page
requirements.description: Must be standard/flexible as requirements for new profiles are highly variable and include custom payload definitions for the API.

requirements.title: Process Workflows (MACD)
requirements.description: The process workflows include standard selection, redirected selection, and external sync.

requirements.title: Defect Prevention and Quality
requirements.description: Prevent regression of defects SADRSTRANG-13583 and SADRSTRANG-13420.

requirements.title: Maximo to ServiceNow (Datavalet) Integration
requirements.description: The integration of Maximo and ServiceNow (Datavalet) systems to enable data synchronization.

requirements.title: Bell Version Workflow
requirements.description: Similar to Datavalet, but follows Bell internal provisioning logic and Maximo job plans.

requirements.title: Offering Name Adjustments and Template Redirection List
requirements.description: Change display name of DV-047 and use the template redirection list for 'Modify Profile' offering.
